    "May lack some advanced reporting depth found in larger ERP systems",
    "Initial data migration from Sage 300 required some effort",
    "Customer support can sometimes be slow to respond to complex queries"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This owner found Xero to be a substantial improvement in usability and accessibility compared to their previous experience with Sage 300. The cloud-based nature and intuitive interface greatly streamlined their financial management tasks as a self-employed individual. While it offered sufficient functionality for their current needs, they noted that some advanced reporting capabilities might not match those of more comprehensive ERP systems."
